head: 0ebf7d9e0f4f91881cce4d1368c9e62826fcc98a
verdict: material
findings:
- docs/tasks/T-am8b.md:49 R12: The supplied plan selects cmd-tally-count-subpackage and unicode-isspace, and its independent review approves both subject only to resolving record placement. This paragraph asserts an operator instruction reversing those selections, but no such instruction or confirmation is present in the supplied issue, plan, answers or handoffs; it explicitly leaves confirmation pending. The architecture still defers both reviewed choices and omits their ADRs. Restore the selected architecture and records, or supply the authorized revision and record its confirmation on the issue before treating the replacement scope as approved.
- docs/adr/README.md:20 R10: The record-placement resolution adds product ADRs but retains the rule that records cite only sibling constitutive documents. ADR-0010 instead requires citations of the product PRD and specification, and ADR-0011 through ADR-0015 use those citations. Thus the guidance still both prohibits and requires the new records' product references. Update this rule to explicitly permit product requirements and specifications, consistent with ADR-0010, so the plan review's record-placement condition is fully resolved.
